protocol.train: at least one month (4,320) of healthy ten-minute readings: the whole previous calendar month, reached further back a week at a time (at most 92 days) until the rows the reference itself calls anomalous are trimmed out and a month of readings remains
protocol.predict: the whole month, from the turbine's measured load and the ERA5 ambient temperature
protocol.alarm: a robust z-score above 3 on the healthy model's residual
protocol.dispatch: an alarm sustained for at least 6 consecutive ten-minute samples
protocol.healthy_assumed: every month of every turbine, except the documented anomaly spans

sibling.compare: the turbine's bearing temperature against its siblings' median at the same ten-minute moment, only where its power is within 0.1 of rated of theirs
sibling.day: the median gap over the day, with at least 36 comparable readings
sibling.normal: the median daily gap over the model's training window
sibling.call_out: a run of consecutive flagged days is one call-out, dispatched at the end of its first day
sibling.confirmed: the model must also find a z-score above 2 that day
sibling.strategy: the veto (z2_s6) plus the sibling call-outs, counted once per day
